pages.title: Management Center 平台治理管理

limitations: Original split sources tested first; final artifact rechecked after provenance-only adapter correction.
file: protocol blocked by automation; double-click was not tested.
Canvas and reduced-motion paths forced with diagnostic query parameters; OS preference and physical touch not changed.
Node touch/low-performance event tests are not physical hardware acceptance.
Snapshot failure intentionally uses simplified DOM fail-safe, not a claimed 48-band mesh.
Owner visual acceptance and Production are separate gates.
harnessCorrections: Offline close selector corrected from nonexistent data-close-right to observed data-collapse-right.
Renderer assertion corrected from shorthand webgl to observed diagnostic webgl-mesh; actual render succeeded throughout.
